premises.text: Web data is valuable but currently trapped inside HTML and not accessible to everyone
premises.evidence_span: this data is valuable. If we could release it, well, the impact would be huge. It would help you make better informed decisions at work, ensure you have the information to hold your government accountable, and even make sure you got home safely after a good night out.

premises.text: The majority of websites do not have an API, and creating one is complex
premises.evidence_span: the majority of sites do not have an API. And creating one is complex.

premises.text: Import.io allows users to turn any website into a table of data or an API without writing code
premises.evidence_span: imagine if you could turn any website into a table of data or an API in a matter of minutes without writing code.

premises.text: Users can create APIs from web pages quickly and easily using the Import.io data browser
premises.evidence_span: I open the Import I.O. data browser, navigate to a web page that has the data on it that I want, and click the I.O. button.

premises.text: Combining created APIs with other APIs is easy and allows for scalable data integration
premises.evidence_span: Combining the API that I just created with other APIs is very easy.

premises.text: The Data Factory will provide access to a library of APIs for users
premises.evidence_span: The Data Factory is a Chrome extension that will allow anybody to get access to our library of APIs.

premises.text: Import.io aims to double the number of publicly available APIs in the next three months
premises.evidence_span: In the past 13 years, there have only been 10,000 publicly available APIs created. In the next three months, Import.io will double that number.

value.text: Data becomes easily accessible to everyone through Import.io
value.evidence_span: for the first time ever, data on the web would be easily accessible to everyone, representing a significant step forward in information accessibility.

notes: User metrics and specific examples of API usage are excluded as traction.
